deviations: Population and counter kind complete the prose contract. Original report processes every metric; counter filtering is a deliberate new planted defect, not a source claim. Original report results is a list, not a dictionary overwriting repeated names.

Local bounded JSON source snapshots make the prose source field reproducible. The performance defect is unbuffered byte-at-a-time file I/O with an already-correct bytearray, not repeated immutable-prefix copies or name frequency counting. All data is ordinary pilot receipts; no fake delay/network.

Finite number and Counter identity helpers are correct from the start, avoiding14/06 nonfinite bypass and13/05 names.count duplication. Timestamp, contract freeze and fixed first-N selection helpers are also supplied.

The example pass/fail thresholds are retained; incomplete batches ambiguous, counter workload limit and exact fixed-batch/EOF policies are exercise rules. The entire pilot write guardrail covers excluded/wrong-population evidence. This is not a sliding-window median problem or statistical guarantee.

Private TAP-style rows are fully specified with a correct helper, not asserted to be a lesson protocol. GQM tree/metric catalog sharing and fail>ambiguous>pass aggregation are deterministic exercise representations; only root-plan outcome+guardrail coverage is required.
